purpose: A Bearer challenge on a plaintext response is a different scheme and must not be reported as a Basic challenge.

groundTruth.rationale: The value offers the Bearer scheme only. The rule matches the Basic scheme token, not any authentication challenge.

limitations: Observation mode: proves scheme discrimination only; Bearer over plaintext is a separate transport finding (DPK-DAST-001).
